title: BTDM-CDSS: Brain Tumor Diagnosis Model - Clinical Decision Support System
description: Research software accompanying Singh, Pokharel and Pant, 'Deep learning techniques for brain tumour diagnosis via multi-source domain alignment with contrastive learning' (npj Digital Medicine, under review). Hybrid EfficientNet-B0/Transformer four-class MRI classifier (Seed 42 checkpoint, 25,057,731 parameters; SHA-256 604e1b4191cd27fc14a8500d613578a137f31ad98b742b765e6a59ba794abce2), deployed as a web-based clinical decision support system with per-doctor workspaces, audit logging and a model version lock. Research use only; not a medical device.
